title: Mens 10K 14K 18K Gold Lab Grown Diamond Eternity Band, Beveled Edge, Brushed, 6mm
description:
A solid gold band, 6 mm wide, with a brushed satin face and one beveled edge set with round lab grown diamonds all the way around. The other edge is a plain polished bevel, so the stones catch the light from one side of the band and the brushed face stays clean.

YOUR RING
Solid gold in 10K, 14K or 18K, in yellow, white or rose gold. About 6 mm wide and about 1.8 mm thick, flat with squared shoulders. The outer face has a fine brushed satin finish; the bevels and the inside are polished. One edge is cut into a narrow polished bevel that holds a single row of round brilliant lab grown diamonds, about 1.3 mm each, set side by side with small gold beads between them, all the way around the band. The other edge has no stones. The number of stones depends on the ring size, because the row always closes the full circle. The price is for one ring in your selected karat, size and color; all the lab grown diamonds are included.

CHOOSE YOUR OPTIONS
1. Karat: 10K, 14K or 18K gold.
2. Ring Size: US 4 to US 16, including half sizes. One price for every size and color in each karat.
3. Metal Color: yellow, white or rose gold.

SIZING: THIS BAND CANNOT BE RESIZED
The lab grown diamonds run all the way around the edge, so there is no plain section a jeweler could cut or stretch, and the size is set when the band is made. Please have your finger measured by a jeweler before ordering. Wide bands fit more snugly than thin ones; if you are between sizes, message us before ordering.

ABOUT THE LAB GROWN DIAMONDS
Laboratory-grown diamonds are grown above ground and have the same crystal structure, hardness and brilliance as mined diamonds; they are not simulants. Each stone is a round brilliant cut, so the row reads as one line of light around the edge.

THE SETTING
Each stone sits in the polished bevel and is held by small gold beads shared with its neighbours. Set in the bevel at the edge of the band, the stones show from the side and from above while the brushed face stays plain.

MADE FOR YOU
Made to order from raw precious-metal materials. The preparation time before dispatch is shown in the shipping details of this listing; transit time is separate.

CARE
Clean gently with mild soap, lukewarm water and a soft brush, then pat dry. Avoid harsh chemicals and abrasive cleaners. Remove the ring before heavy work or sport.
